items.title: Coarse frequency offset estimation and compensation based on short-time spectrum analysis in FSO communication system
items.blocker: No lawful auditable full text; title/metadata cannot bear action classification.

items.title: A coherent communication scheme characterized by low complexity and enhanced robustness

action_fields.method_action: fixed-training-spectrum FFT coarse FOE followed by training-arrangement differential-conjugate fine FOE
action_fields.information_source: frame-synchronized known QPSK training samples, spectral peak, adjacent-symbol phase difference
action_fields.decision_granularity: per-frame CFO scalar estimation and compensation
action_fields.lag_window_block_parameters: training length globally fixed at 960 after B2B sweep; no lag or B_L action
action_fields.fixed_adaptive: fixed estimator structure and training length
action_fields.condition_inputs: none; received power, SNR, and turbulence are evaluation strata only
action_fields.online_offline: feed-forward receiver estimator; experimental validation uses offline MATLAB DSP
action_fields.comparators: Wang 2023 FSTS [10]; Wu 2022 TS/FFT plus fourth-power FFT [12]

items.title: Joint OSNR and Frequency Offset Estimation Using Signal Spectrum Correlations

action_fields.method_action: FO sweep and upper/lower spectral-component SCDF curve fitting for coarse FOE/FOC, followed by downsampled fourth-power FFT fine FOE
action_fields.information_source: post-CDC received samples and upper/lower sideband spectral-component correlations
action_fields.lag_window_block_parameters: 100 MHz filters; fixed sweep +/-7.5 GHz, delta-F 1 GHz, threshold 0.4, q=14, fine FFT size 72
action_fields.fixed_adaptive: parameters globally optimized offline then fixed
action_fields.condition_inputs: none for parameter selection; OSNR and modulation formats are evaluation conditions
action_fields.online_offline: deterministic receiver DSP; experimental capture processed offline
action_fields.comparators: no FOC; perfect FOC; conventional FFT-FOE

items.classification_note: contains offline parameter optimization, but no target lag/B_L/window action
